description: Accessible Parking Spaces DLR is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. Location of accessible car parking spaces on roads and streets within the Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council administrative area. Fields include index, ITM coordinates, street name, description and signage/road marking information. Please note that the dataset is incomplete and is currently being reviewed and updated. Coverage: Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. Its tags are DLR, DLRCC, Dun Laoghaire-Rathdown, Transport and Infrastructure, accessibility. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, DB_TABLE, GEOJSON, KML, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
